visual_action: Karoline Leavitt speaks from a podium in what appears to be the White House press briefing room. She is wearing a light green blazer. The video concludes with a black screen showing a white line drawing of the White House and text identifying it as the White House of President Donald J. Trump.

cast.name: Karoline Leavitt
cast.evidence: Shown speaking at the White House podium for the entire duration of the speech. Identified by face-ID and an on-screen text overlay that reads "Karoline Leavitt Says..."

cast.name: Democratic Party
cast.evidence: Repeatedly named as the party running high-crime cities. Leavitt states, "...these cities is all in cities that are run by Democrats."

cast.name: Donald J. Trump
cast.evidence: His name appears on the final title card of the video: "THE WHITE HOUSE PRESIDENT DONALD J. TRUMP".

on_screen_text.text:
THE WHITE HOUSE
Karoline Leavitt Says High Crime States are All Run by Democrats
There is crime in all states, but the crime in
these cities is all in cities that are run by Democrats.
If you look at the the list of the top 20 high crime cities in the United States,
every single one, with the exception of one
in Louisiana, is run by a Democrat.

THE WHITE HOUSE
PRESIDENT DONALD J. TRUMP

spoken_summary: Karoline Leavitt argues that while crime exists everywhere, it is concentrated in cities run by Democrats. She claims that of the top 20 high-crime cities in the US, all but one are run by a Democrat.
audio_music: The audio consists entirely of clear, spoken dialogue from Karoline Leavitt. There is no background music or sound effects.
editing_pacing: The video is a single, static talking-head shot of the speaker at a podium. It features text overlays and synchronized captions, cutting to a final title card at the end.
central_claim: The Democratic Party's governance is the cause of high crime rates in major US cities.
intended_effect: To convince viewers that Democrats are responsible for crime and should be voted out of office.
